title: Binance Will Support the Qualcomm Incorporated (QCOM), PayPal (PYPL) and Alphabet (GOOGL) Cash Dividend Distribution via bStocks
text: This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. bStocks are offered through an Approved Prospectus in the ADGM and are not offered in any other jurisdiction.  bStocks are Tokenized securities issued by BTech Holdings PYPL Limited, a Binance group affiliate. bStocks are classified as Certificates representing certain Financial Instruments (paragraph 92, Schedule 1 to FSMR). bStocks represent an interest in underlying securities held by the Issuer and are not direct ownership of the underlying Shares. bStocks do not allow holders to directly own a share or stock in the underlying listed company. Fellow Binancians, Binance will support the Qualcomm Incorporated (QCOM), PayPal (PYPL) and  Alphabet (GOOGL)   cash dividend distribution via bStocks for QCOMB, PYPLB,  GOOGLB  holders. Net amount of the cash dividend will be reinvested after applicable withholding taxes, fees, costs, and other deductions, into additional units or fractions of the same underlying security. Eligible users will receive dividends in the form of QCOMB, PYPLB and  GOOGLB  bStocks respectively. On-chain holders of QCOMB, PYPLB and  GOOGLB  will receive the bStock dividends through a multiplier adjustment. Eligibility Users with QCOMB holdings on the record date snapshot at  2026-09-03 00:00 (UTC)  will be eligible for the dividend distribution. Users with PYPLB holdings on the record date snapshot at  2026-09-04 00:00 (UTC)  will be eligible for the dividend distribution. Users with  GOOGLB  holdings on the record date snapshot at  2026-09-04 00:00 (UTC)  will be eligible for the dividend distribution. General Trading of QCOMB/USDT, PYPLB/USDT,  GOOGLB /USDT  will not be affected. QCOMB: At  2026-09-02 23:30 (UTC) , the token conversion service for 1:1 swaps between QCOM stock and QCOMB bStocks will be suspended. At  2026-09-02 23:30 (UTC) , deposits and withdrawals of QCOMB tokens will be suspended. Users should ensure they leave sufficient time for their QCOMB token deposits to be fully processed prior to this time.  PYPLB: At  2026-09-03 23:30 (UTC) , the token conversion service for 1:1 swaps between PYPL stock and PYPLB bStocks will be suspended. At  2026-09-03 23:30 (UTC) , deposits and withdrawals of PYPLB will be suspended. Users should ensure they leave sufficient time for their PYPLB deposits to be fully processed prior to this time.  GOOGLB : At  2026-09-03 23:30 (UTC) , the token conversion service for 1:1 swaps between  GOOGL  stock and  GOOGLB  bStocks will be suspended. At  2026-09-03 23:30 (UTC) , deposits and withdrawals of  GOOGLB  will be suspended. Users should ensure they leave sufficient time for their  GOOGLB  deposits to be fully processed prior to this time.  Deposits, withdrawals, and token conversion service for QCOMB, PYPLB and  GOOGLB  will resume when the distribution is completed. No further announcement will be posted. Users can also subscribe to the recovery notification where available. Dividends earned from assets held in other accounts will be credited to Spot Account, including but not limited to Savings Account, Margin Account, etc. Binance will handle all technical requirements for users who are involved in this event. Reinvestment and distribution of dividends is after deduction of withholding tax.  Users may refer to the announcements from the companies for more information. For more information about bStocks dividend distribution, please refer to the  FAQ . Convert Binance Convert will pause the conversion of QCOMB and all associated pairs at  2026-09-02 23:30 (UTC) . Binance Convert will pause the conversion of PYPLB and all associated pairs at  2026-09-03 23:30 (UTC) . Binance Convert will pause the conversion of  GOOGLB  and all associated pairs at  2026-09-03 23:30 (UTC) .
